tithi.name: એકાદશી
tithi.description: ઉપવાસ અને આધ્યાત્મિક શિસ્તનો દિવસ, પ્રાર્થના અને દાન માટે યોગ્ય.

Mesha.summary: Energy surges, making it a perfect day to start new initiatives.
Mesha.general: You feel a boost of confidence and enthusiasm. Use this momentum for personal growth.
Mesha.career: New projects may receive unexpected support; collaborate wisely.
Mesha.finance: A small gain is possible; avoid impulsive investments.
Mesha.relationships: Passionate conversations can deepen bonds; listen more than speak.
Mesha.health: Channel excess energy into exercise; avoid overexertion.
Mesha.remedy: Light a red candle and chant the Gayatri mantra.

Vrishabha.summary: Steady progress marks the day, rewarding patience.
Vrishabha.general: Your practical nature shines; focus on long‑term goals.
Vrishabha.career: Tasks requiring detail will be completed efficiently.
Vrishabha.finance: Savings grow slowly; consider reviewing budgets.
Vrishabha.relationships: Comfort in familiar company; plan a quiet dinner.
Vrishabha.health: Maintain a balanced diet; avoid heavy meals at night.
Vrishabha.remedy: Offer milk to a cow and recite the Vishnu Sahasranama.

Mithuna.general: Social interactions are highlighted; share ideas openly.
Mithuna.career: Presentations and meetings are favored; speak with clarity.
Mithuna.finance: A short‑term profit may arise from a conversation; stay alert.
Mithuna.relationships: Light‑hearted chats bring joy; avoid gossip.
Mithuna.health: Take short walks to keep the mind fresh.
Mithuna.remedy: Wear a yellow thread on the right wrist and chant Om Namah Shivaya.

Karka.summary: Emotions run deep; nurture inner harmony.
Karka.general: Introspection is beneficial; honor your feelings.
Karka.career: Avoid making hasty decisions; seek counsel.
Karka.finance: Hold off on major purchases; review expenses.
Karka.relationships: Family time brings comfort; express gratitude.
Karka.health: Practice gentle yoga or meditation to soothe nerves.
Karka.remedy: Donate white rice to a charitable cause and chant the Mahamrityunjaya mantra.

Simha.summary: Leadership qualities shine; take the spotlight.
Simha.general: Confidence is high; channel it constructively.
Simha.career: A chance to lead a project appears; accept it.
Simha.finance: Recognition may bring a bonus; stay humble.
Simha.relationships: Romantic gestures are appreciated; be sincere.
Simha.health: Maintain moderate activity; avoid overconfidence in physical feats.
Simha.remedy: Offer a garland of flowers to a deity and chant the Surya mantra.

Kanya.summary: Attention to detail brings success in tasks.
Kanya.general: Analytical thinking is enhanced; organize your space.
Kanya.career: Finish pending paperwork; accuracy will be praised.
Kanya.finance: A modest gain from careful budgeting; avoid speculation.
Kanya.relationships: Offer practical help to loved ones; it deepens trust.
Kanya.health: Focus on digestive health; drink warm water.
Kanya.remedy: Recite the Saraswati mantra and keep a small notebook for thoughts.

Tula.summary: Balance is key; seek harmony in all areas.
Tula.general: Strive for equilibrium between work and leisure.
Tula.career: Negotiations favor you; aim for win‑win outcomes.
Tula.finance: Mid‑day expenses should be monitored; avoid splurging.
Tula.relationships: A calm conversation can resolve lingering issues.
Tula.health: Practice breathing exercises to maintain steadiness.
Tula.remedy: Place a pink rose near your workspace and chant the Shukra mantra.

Vrischika.general: Deep insights arise; trust your intuition.
Vrischika.career: A hidden opportunity may surface; be ready to act.
Vrischika.finance: Investments made earlier may show returns; stay patient.
Vrischika.relationships: Honest dialogue can heal old wounds.
Vrischika.health: Meditation helps manage stress; avoid stimulants.
Vrischika.remedy: Offer black sesame seeds to a Shiva lingam and chant Om Namah Shivaya.

Dhanu.summary: Optimism expands horizons; explore new ideas.
Dhanu.general: Adventure beckons; plan a short trip or learning activity.
Dhanu.career: Creative proposals are welcomed; present them confidently.
Dhanu.finance: A small windfall may arrive; use it for education or travel.
Dhanu.relationships: Share your visions with partners; inspire each other.
Dhanu.health: Outdoor activities boost vitality; wear comfortable shoes.
Dhanu.remedy: Light a blue lamp and recite the Guru mantra.

Makara.general: Structure and routine support your goals.
Makara.career: Stick to the plan; progress will be noticeable.
Makara.finance: Savings increase slowly; avoid risky ventures.
Makara.relationships: Show reliability to loved ones; it builds trust.
Makara.health: Maintain regular sleep patterns; avoid late nights.
Makara.remedy: Donate black beans and chant the Shani mantra.

Kumbha.summary: Innovation sparks; think outside the box.
Kumbha.general: Your mind is inventive; apply fresh solutions.
Kumbha.career: Tech‑related tasks thrive; propose new methods.
Kumbha.finance: A surprising refund may appear; use it wisely.
Kumbha.relationships: Engage in group activities; friendships deepen.
Kumbha.remedy: Offer water to a sacred river and chant the Varuna mantra.

Meena.summary: Intuition guides you; trust inner wisdom.
Meena.general: Dreams may carry messages; keep a journal.
Meena.career: Creative projects gain momentum; follow your heart.
Meena.finance: A charitable donation returns blessings; consider giving.
Meena.health: Gentle swimming or water yoga restores balance.
Meena.remedy: Light a sea‑green incense and chant the Saraswati mantra.
